about: The incident's front-page record, kept by incident.conductor@web-summit.dinis. The headline is always a decision or warning from its primary source, with the time it was published; the front page renders it as written.
title: Storm Charles, Lisbon: Wednesday 11 November 2026

headline.text: Web Summit calls off Day 2 (Wednesday) on the government's advice; Day 3 (Thursday) "aims to proceed as planned"
headline.at: 10 Nov 2026, 19:09 UTC (page data; read at source 20:58)
headline.label: fact

standfirst: IPMA's red warnings for Lisbon on Wednesday: rain 09:00 to 18:00 (moved three hours earlier at 21:23 on Tuesday), wind 12:00 to 21:00. The government's alert situation covers all of mainland Portugal on Wednesday: schools and non-essential public services closed, outdoor events suspended.
thursday: Web Summit "aims to proceed" with Day 3: an aim, not yet a promise. Still unannounced: Wednesday's talks, the PITCH semi-final, side events, tickets.
